Hi all,

Thanks for signing up for our multi-company office hours/demo cohort. We want to run a compact 45-minute walkthrough focused on inference economics, best-practice deployment patterns, and a short live Q&A specific to customer workflows.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Sep 7 — 10:00–10:45 AM PT
- Wed Sep 8 — 1:00–1:45 PM PT
- Thu Sep 9 — 4:00–4:45 PM PT

Please reply with the single slot that works best for your team. If none of these work, indicate an alternate 90-minute window this week and we'll try to accommodate.

Agenda (draft):
- 0–10m: quick intros + goals from each company
- 10–25m: demo — routing, batching, and cost controls
- 25–35m: Q&A / troubleshooting specific workloads
- 35–45m: next steps / POC cadence

Attachments: redwood-cohort-agenda.pdf (PDF)

Logistics: we'll run the session from a shared Zoom and send calendar invites once a majority confirms. Also looping in Lauren and Karthik to coordinate host roles.

Thanks,
